about:
# LS: Toasts

Replacement for the default alert system. Better toasts, cheers!

![image](https://i.imgur.com/PvzX6VF.gif)

## Download

- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/ls-toasts)
- [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/ls-toasts)

## Options

- Use **`/LSTOASTS`** or **`/LST`** to open in-game config.
- Anchors and most of their settings are available via **Edit Mode**.
- Go to **Options** > **AddOns** > **LS: Toasts** to manage profiles and the layout data.

## Feedback and Feature Requests

If you found a bug or want to share an idea on how to improve my addon, either use the issue tracker on [GitHub](https://github.com/ls-/ls_Toasts/issues) or join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/7QcJgQkDYD) server.

## Localisation

Feel free to add and/or review translations on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/ls-toasts/localization), alternatively, you may create a PR on [project's GitHub page](https://github.com/ls-/ls_Toasts/pulls).

## FAQ

**Q:** Is it possible to use the default achievement/loot/etc toast while using the addon?
**A:** No, the default system is written in a way that makes it hard or even impossible to toggle parts of it individually.

releases.notes: - Added a toggle for Slug rendering to the font settings. Disabled by default.
- Use SLUG rendering for fonts by default.

- Added WoW Forever support.
- Updated Traditional Chinese translation. Translated by BNS333@Curse.

- Added a button to reset the anchor frame's position to the config panel. It should help in cases where the frame gets
  lost due to past shenanigans from other addons.
- Added info on where to find anchor frames and their settings to the config panel.
- Added a frame to adjust the position of the anchor frame while in Edit Mode. Unfortunately, for now it's not
  pixel-perfect because this requires a more substantial updated to the underlying Edit Mode library rather than my
  addon.
- Added dummy toasts to anchor frames in Edit Mode which should make it easier to locate them on the screen.

- Added the manager for layout-specific settings. There you can reset, copy, and delete them. Available at the
  "Layouts" tab in Blizz config panel.
- Added the `/lst reparentanchors` command (case-insensitive) to reset positions of all anchors in case they got lost
  for some reason.
